H.; Baer וַיִּקְרָם , of which conflicting explanations Ges §§ 9u , 29i), indefinite subject instead of passive; but read Niph`al ᵑ6 וַיִּקָּ֫רֶם (compare ᵑ9 ) Co Berthol Toy Krae. קרן (√ of following; meaning dubious; compare Assyrian ‡arnu , Arabic , Ethiopic Late Hebrew קֶרֶן , Phoenician קרן , Aramaic קַרְנָא , , all horn ; Sabean קרן spur of mountain (?)
